{{Quote|Despite frequent Imperial patrols, an entire society of vagrants, petty criminals and refugees has flourished among the greasy alleys which honeycomb Biivren's industrial sector.|[[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]], ''[[Smuggler's Handbook/Legends|Smuggler's Handbook]]''|<ref name="Platt">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>}}
